Adani Wilmar (Fortune Spices).event: The company officially changed its name to AWL Agri Business Limited following approval from its shareholders and approval of the name switch in April 2025.
Adani Wilmar (Fortune Spices).evidence: Adani Wilmar rebranded to AWL Agri Business Limited in 2025 following the Adani Group's planned exit from the joint venture according to news reports and company filings. The company offers spices under its premium Kohinoor brand portfolio and has aggressively expanded its spices and food footprint through acquisitions such as GD Foods (Tops brand).
